newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX energy prices turn narrowly mixed Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX energy prices turn narrowly mixed Wednesday.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures were narrowly mixed in thin overnight trade, with little trade expected until the floor session starts Thursday, traders said.
"There's very little volume," one broker said. adding that overnight interest typically fades the day after inventory reports are released.
April NYMEX crude gained eight cents on ACCESS, trading $21.19 a barrel after settling up 11 cents on the day.
About 384 lots traded in April, with 445 traded overall, brokers said.
Trade sources said support was seen at $20.65, and pegged resistance at $21.45 a barrel.
March gasoline futures were offered 62.45 cents a gallon, bid 61.71 cent and last traded 62 cents, brokers said.

The contract dropped 0.26 cents from the settle as 33 lots changed hands. Traders forecast increased activity this week, with open interest fairly ahead ahead of Friday's expiry. ahead of the contract expiry.
Front-month heating oil edged up 0.02 cent from the settle to 56.70 a gallon. Offers stood at 56.85 cents as 41 lots changed hands, traders said.
